name: @tieuannguyen/avf
description: AVF — Automation Validation Framework (evaluate & evolve automation engines against a constant benchmark)

scripts.test:all: npm run test:foundation && npm run test:analytics-stack && npm run test:presentation-stack && npm run test:integration-stack
scripts.test:quick: npm run test:kernel && npm run test:connectors
scripts.test:foundation: npm run test:kernel && npm run test:connectors && npm run test:evolution && npm run test:bridge && npm run test:extract && npm run test:policy && npm run test:autoselect && npm run test:h5 && npm run test:refbridge && npm run test:oracle

scripts.test:presentation-stack: npm run test:report && npm run test:overview && npm run test:dashboard
scripts.test:integration-stack: npm run test:jira && npm run test:cli && npm run test:examples
scripts.test:analytics: node analytics/snapshot.test.mjs && node analytics/artifact.test.mjs && node analytics/trend.test.mjs && node analytics/render.test.mjs && node analytics/properties.test.mjs
scripts.test:decision: node decision/decision.test.mjs && node decision/artifact.test.mjs && node decision/render.test.mjs && node decision/boundary.test.mjs && node decision/properties.test.mjs
